description: This file defines a protocol for location services, providing default implementations and support functions for requesting user location, handling authorization status, and managing the CLLocationManager. It serves as a support module for location-related features in an app.

methods.name: configureLocationManager
methods.description: Sets up the CLLocationManager delegate and desired accuracy.

methods.name: authorizationStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current authorization status for location services.

methods.name: accuracyAuthorization
methods.description: Returns the accuracy authorization status for the CLLocationManager.

methods.name: requestLocationOnce
methods.description: Asynchronously requests a single location update using a continuation.
